key_insight: Infinity-Wasserstein robust PCA admits an exact finite-dimensional reformulation while retaining samplewise residual information that can reshape the learned principal subspace.
engineering_relevance: The method offers a principled way to make dimensionality reduction more resilient to distributional uncertainty in representation-learning pipelines.
method: Formulate PCA with an infinity-Wasserstein distributional uncertainty set and explicitly construct a worst-case distribution.
Establish a uniform finite-sample performance guarantee assuming the true distribution has a finite fourth moment.
Solve the nonconvex, nonsmooth reformulation using iteratively reweighted majorization-minimization with convergence analysis.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports numerical experiments supporting computational efficiency and downstream effectiveness, but provides no datasets, metrics, or quantitative gains.
watch_item: The optimization remains nonconvex, so convergence analysis should not be interpreted as a guarantee of finding a global optimum.
paper_title: Infinity-Wasserstein Distributionally Robust Principal Component Analysis: Exact Reformulation, Finite-Sample Guarantee, and Efficient Algorithm
